scope: HF layers at native hidden/KV/shared-index inputs; independent rollout separate

weight_arithmetic.integer_projection: W8: INT32 dot * FP32 weight scale * FP32 A8 scale; W4: CANN 9.2.0 API-dequant MSD with FP16 partials
weight_arithmetic.tp_sum: FP32 rank-order sum, final BF16; not bitwise HCCL
weight_arithmetic.fused_rounding: W4 FP16 partials; activation boundaries set by HF adapters

rotary.intermediates: FP32 products and sum; one BF16 output cast
rotary.angles: HF FP32 generation followed by BF16 cast
rotary.hf_adapter: Instance forward globals; HF bytecode unchanged

c8_index_scoring.scale_restoration: none; scores retain the common 1/1024 factor
unverified_device_boundaries: FP16 subnormal handling and overflow saturation
c8_index_scoring.accepted_fp16_domain: finite normal values or zero for wire operands and weight*q_scale
